title: A logical approach to concentration
summary: Concentration results say that a sequence of random variables becomes progressively concentrated around the mean. Such results are common in the study of functions of random graphs. We introduce a real-valued logic with various aggregate operators on graphs, including summation, and prove that every term in the language, seen as a random variable on random graphs within the classical Erdős-Rényi random graph model, is concentrated. We prove this for dense and sparse variants of Erdős-Rényi graphs. On the one hand, our results extend the line of work originating with Fagin and Glebskii et al.…
